newsitem.title: UK: Shell up as NatWest raises Q3 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Shell up as NatWest raises Q3 estimates.

text.p: Shares in Shell Transport and Trading climbed in a falling market on Wednesday as NatWest Securities raised profit estimates after record third-quarter results from Shell Oil Co., market sources said.

Shares in the Anglo-Dutch oil group's British arm were up nine pence at 1,059-1/2p, with over 1.6 million shares traded. The shares have risen by more than 24 percent this year, also helped by firmer oil prices.
Market sources said NatWest raised its estimates for "clean" net income on a replacement cost basis for the third quarter by 20 million stg to 1.152 bln stg.
Shell Oil Co. said on Tuesday third quarter net income rose $90 million to $504 million.
